metadata.purpose: W5 composite meta-entries injected into the model catalog so MoE / Stacking / Voting / Multimodal show up as pickable in ModelCatalogPicker.
metadata.consumed_by: apps/api/lib/catalogBridge.ts (mergeCompositeExtras) + scripts/generate_model.py (--composite mode resolves these template IDs)

extras.name: Mixture of Experts (Composite)
extras.overview: Routes inputs to N expert sub-models via a learned gating network. Each expert is a separately-trained model from the catalog. Top-K (sparse) or full-softmax (dense) routing supported. Pioneered by Shazeer et al. 2017 'Outrageously Large Neural Networks' and adopted in Switch Transformer (Fedus 2022).
principles: Top-K or soft routing -- each token attends to k of n_experts experts
Per-expert specialization driven by routing supervision
Sparse computation -- only k of n_experts forward-pass per sample
applications: Heterogeneous market regimes (one expert per regime)

hyperparameters.name: gating_type
hyperparameters.description: Routing strategy: top_k (sparse), soft (dense softmax), hash (deterministic)

hyperparameters.name: gating_k
hyperparameters.description: Number of experts active per sample (top_k only)

hyperparameters.name: gate_epochs
hyperparameters.description: Epochs to train the routing head

extras.name: Stacking Ensemble (Composite)
extras.overview: Wolpert (1992) stacked generalization: N base sub-models predict on the same fold; their predictions become meta-features for a meta-learner (LogisticRegression by default) that produces the final composite prediction. Better diversity than voting because the meta-learner can downweight correlated base learners.
principles: Base learners trained on same fold -- diversity from architectural difference
Meta-learner combines base predictions -- learnable, not arithmetic
Walk-forward fold acts as the holdout for meta-fit (sklearn StackingClassifier cv=prefit pattern)
applications: Combining heterogeneous models (e.g. tree + MLP + sklearn)
Calibration smoothing -- meta-learner re-balances over-confident bases
keyFeatures: Per-base member predictions exposed in diagnostics

extras.name: Voting Ensemble (Composite)
extras.overview: N sub-models predict independently. Combine via hard vote (majority class), soft vote (probability average), or weighted vote (user weights). Cheaper than stacking because no meta-learner; baseline ensemble for cases where bases are already well-calibrated.
principles: Each member learns independently -- no shared parameters
Diversity bound: Var(ensemble) <= mean(Var(members)) when members uncorrelated
applications: Quick ensemble of strong individual models
Calibration-stable bases where meta-learner adds noise
Tie-breaker among architecturally different bases (tree + linear + MLP)
keyFeatures: Per-member mean prediction surfaced for diversity analysis

extras.name: Multimodal Encoder Fusion (Composite)
extras.overview: Multi-stream encoder with per-modality encoder picker (mlp / cnn / transformer) and learnable fusion (concat / cross-attention / gated). Each modality is a column slice of the feature matrix routed through its own encoder. Unlike MoE/stacking/voting where members are SEPARATELY trained models, multimodal encoders are inline blocks composed in one nn.Module.
principles: Per-modality encoders specialise on their input distribution
Fusion strategy controls how modalities exchange information
Joint end-to-end training of encoders + fusion + head via NLLLoss
applications: Multi-timeframe fusion (1m + 5m + 15m features as separate modalities)
Cross-asset fusion (asset A price + asset B price)
